title: Lay out codec tokens for a language model
brief: Build the MusicGen delay pattern and its inverse, VALL-E's autoregressive and non-autoregressive inputs, MaskGIT's cosine schedule and confidence-based decoding, and a tiny codec language model whose loss reaches a known entropy.
hints: apply_delay: start from np.full((K, T + K - 1), pad) and write codes[k] into out[k, k:k + T].
maskgit_decode: set confidence[~masked] = np.inf, sort with np.argsort, and keep the first n_keep positions masked.
markov_code_entropy: the rows of A @ B are p(c1 at t | c0 at t - 1). Weight each row's entropy by the stationary distribution pi.
masked_cross_entropy: torch.where(mask, targets, 0) gives valid classes everywhere; multiply the per-token losses by the mask and divide by mask.sum().
